relationships.subject: mediodorsal thalamic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate the sensory stimuli ACC neurons process are predetermined by their presynaptic MD inputs.

relationships.subject: ACC layer II/III itch-specific neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Chemogenetic inhibition of these neurons reduced pruriception or nociception without affecting the opposite modality.

key_findings: Modality-specific itch and pain neuronal subsets exist in ACC layer II/III and receive modality-matched MD thalamic synaptic inputs.
Chemogenetic inhibition reduced itch or pain without affecting the opposite modality.
